page_title: Petrichor - An offline music player for macOS

summary.name: Petrichor
summary.one_liner: Petrichor is an offline music player for macOS that plays almost any audio format and organizes your local music library.
use_cases: organize a local music collection on a Mac
play all tracks by a specific artist
browse music by decade or genre
play a single album from a large library
listen to music offline without streaming
summary.what_it_does: Petrichor is a music player for macOS that you point at your music folders to build a library. You can browse the library by Artists, Album Artists, Composers, Genres, Decades, or Years. After choosing a type and item, its tracks are shown grouped by album, so you can play all of an artist's work or a single album. Search is described as fast across thousands of tracks. The page states it never modifies your files on disk.
notable: Browse by Artists, Album Artists, Composers, Genres, Decades, or Years
Tracks grouped by album under each browsed item
caveats: Platform support appears limited to macOS
Pricing and licensing not stated on the page
